# twenty_field

Manages a workspace Custom application's nullable `TEXT`, `NUMBER`, `BOOLEAN`, `DATE`, or `DATE_TIME` field. Custom fields on standard company/person objects are supported. Requires the `DATA_MODEL` settings permission. Built-in, system, remote, application-owned, required, and label-identifier fields cannot be managed.

## Example usage

```terraform
data "twenty_object" "company" {
  name_singular = "company"
}

resource "twenty_field" "customer_tier" {
  object_id   = data.twenty_object.company.id
  name        = "customerTier"
  type        = "TEXT"
  label       = "Customer tier"
  description = "Customer support tier"

  # Apply false before destroying. Deletion permanently removes field data.
  deletion_protection = true
}
```

## Scope and deletion

Changing `object_id`, `name`, or `type` requires replacement. There are no type or data migrations. Default values, select options, relationships, and type-specific settings are not managed. Twenty chooses creation defaults; updates leave existing defaults unchanged.

`deletion_protection` defaults to true, including after import. Apply `deletion_protection = false` before destroying or replacing the resource. Deletion permanently removes the field and its CRM data. The provider hard-deletes directly, without deactivation first, because deactivation itself removes view fields and filters.

Labels, descriptions, and icons must use single spaces without surrounding whitespace. Omission or null clears description/icon; an empty string stays empty. Labels do not rename the field.

## Import

Import the native field UUID. The parent object UUID is derived during refresh. Unsupported types, required fields, and protected metadata fail closed.

```shell
# Import the native field UUID, not an object/field composite ID.
terraform import twenty_field.customer_tier 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```

Match configuration to imported values before applying. Creation never adopts a matching name. If a create response does not contain a valid UUID, inspect the workspace and explicitly import the intended field before retrying. If a later read fails after a valid mutation response, the provider retains the UUID in state. Refresh after repairing access or server failures.

The mutation lock covers one provider configuration only. It does not coordinate other aliases, runs, or administrators. Avoid concurrent metadata edits during applies.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) Nonblank display label. Use single spaces without surrounding whitespace.
- `name` (String) ASCII lowerCamel field name, at most 63 characters. The default name field is protected. Create rejects existing names instead of adopting them. Changing it requires replacement.
- `object_id` (String) Parent object's native UUID. Changing it requires replacement.
- `type` (String) One of TEXT, NUMBER, BOOLEAN, DATE, or DATE_TIME. Changing it requires replacement, not a data migration.

### Optional

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Defaults to true. Apply false before destroying or replacing the field. Deletion permanently removes CRM data and does not deactivate the field first.
- `description` (String) Description. Omission or null clears it; empty stays empty. Use single spaces without surrounding whitespace.
- `icon` (String) Icon identifier. Omission or null clears it; empty stays empty. Use single spaces without surrounding whitespace.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Native field UUID used for import.
